description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/godunov_upwind_D1x_extrapolate_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the Godunov-upwind per-axis quantity max(D-x u, 0) - min(D+x u, 0) matched as D(u, wrt: x) (priority 10) replaced by the rule's body (three regions: interior [2,7]x[1,8] and the two ghost wall lines i=1, i=8) carrying the free names dx, dy, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
